advisor_identified: John Michael (J. M., Jack) Bumsted, historian at St. John’s College, University of Manitoba, and supervisor of the listed 1989 thesis.

doctorate.title: The pilgrim's progress: the ecclesiastical history of the Old Colony, 1620-1775

evidence.says: Debra J. Lindsay’s 1989 University of Manitoba PhD thesis, Science in the Sub-Arctic: Traders, Trappers and the Smithsonian Institution, 1859-1870, thanks J. M. Bumsted for supervision in its acknowledgements (p. iv).
University of Manitoba Press states that J. M. (Jack) Bumsted received his PhD from Brown University in 1965 and joined St. John’s College at the University of Manitoba in 1980.

CiNii Books catalogues The pilgrim's progress: the ecclesiastical history of the Old Colony, 1620-1775 by John Michael Bumsted, with the degree note identifying it as a Brown University PhD thesis, 1965.

The University of Manitoba archival finding aid’s biographical sketch (p. 3) independently identifies John Michael Bumsted’s PhD in history as Brown University, 1965, and his University of Manitoba appointment from 1980.

notes: Institution, year, author and substantive title match linked AHA record 12466. The catalogue uses singular possessive ‘pilgrim’s’, whereas the AHA title uses plural possessive ‘Pilgrims’’. The thesis acknowledgements confirm the advisor’s identity.
